editorial_intro: This week brings exciting new releases for streaming, including the highly anticipated 'Drishyam: The Conclusion' and the inspiring biopic 'Hanuman Ansh'. Fans of Indian cinema will find plenty to enjoy, while international hits like 'Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3' also make a splash.

picks.title: Drishyam: The Conclusion
picks.synopsis: In this gripping sequel, Vijay Salgaonkar (Ajay Devgn) faces new challenges as he tries to protect his family from the relentless pursuit of the law. As the investigation into the disappearance of a key witness intensifies, Vijay must use all his cunning and resourcefulness to keep his loved ones safe.
picks.why_watch: This film is a must-watch for fans of suspense and thrillers, delivering unexpected twists that keep you on the edge of your seat. Ajay Devgn's performance is particularly compelling, making it a worthy follow-up to the original.

picks.title: Hanuman Ansh
picks.synopsis: This biopic chronicles the life of Neem Karoli Baba, a revered saint known for his miraculous powers and profound wisdom. The film explores his journey from a humble beginning to becoming a spiritual leader, touching the lives of many, including notable personalities like Steve Jobs.
picks.why_watch: With a blend of spirituality and inspiration, 'Hanuman Ansh' offers a deep dive into the teachings of Neem Karoli Baba, making it a significant watch for those interested in spiritual narratives.

picks.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
picks.synopsis: The Guardians face new threats as they navigate the cosmos, battling foes and dealing with personal conflicts. As they unite to protect the galaxy, they discover the true meaning of family and sacrifice.
picks.why_watch: This film is a thrilling conclusion to the beloved franchise, packed with humor, action, and emotional depth. It's a must-watch for fans of superhero films and the Marvel universe.
